primary_meaning: God the Father (or Yahweh/God in general), representing eternal existence, supreme sovereignty, and divine judgment.

alternatives.meaning: Jesus Christ / God the Son, based on the physical description matching the glorified Christ in Revelation. This is prominent in Eastern Orthodox iconography and patristic tradition.
The undivided Holy Trinity, representing the eternal nature of the entire Godhead rather than a specific divine person.

notes: In Western Christianity and modern biblical scholarship, the Ancient of Days is almost universally understood as God the Father, who is distinct from and grants authority to the Son of Man. However, Eastern Orthodox tradition historically identifies the Ancient of Days as the pre-incarnate or glorified Jesus Christ, drawing parallels to John's vision in Revelation.
